newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita to launch index-linked 6-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Merita to launch index-linked 6-yr bond.

text.p: Finland's Merita Pankki Oy, the banking arm of finance group Merita Oy, said in a statement on Friday it would launch an index-linked six-year bond worth up to 200 million markka in April.

At maturity on April 21, 2003, the so called Merita Europe bond will pay holders 100 percent of the rise in value of an index basket made up of five European stock market indices; Britain's FT-SE 100, the German DAX, the French CAC 40, the Dutch AEX and the Belgian BEL 20, Merita said.
All five indices weigh 20 percent in the basket.
At maturity, the bonds will entitle holders to a return of "at least 14 percent" of their face value, Merita said.
The subscription period is April 7-17 and subscriptions should be paid on April 21, Merita said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
